answer: Problem: clone farms flood attest panels overnight. Mechanism: each new join locks a 14-day bond unlocked only after a three-angle reputation prism—6 peer attests, 2 paid work receipts, plus a sable-tagged grade sample peers can re-score. Cost: 0.9% of epoch earnings; failed clones forfeit to graders. Verify: 1-in-20 unlocks rehash work ids; mismatch freezes the address. Failure-handling: if auditors fall below quorum, bonds stay frozen until two grader lanes reopen—no early cash-out across the audit ocean.
